findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation to raise contrast ratio lacks a specific selector, page URL or element reference.
Priority 2 recommendation to order headings without skipping levels is generic and not anchored to any particular heading instance.
Priority 3 recommendation to wrap primary content in <main> does not specify which page(s) or element(s) need the landmark.
Priority 4 recommendation to replace landmark containers with semantic elements lacks concrete selectors or page context.
Priority 6 recommendation to add missing Schema.org properties is generic and does not name specific properties, entities or selectors.
Priority 7 recommendation to improve Schema.org coverage similarly omits specific property names or entity references.
Optional Enhancements recommendation for Content‑Signal directives is a generic suggestion without any audit‑specific data anchor.
